import openpyxl, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, zipfile, tempfile, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/47741_0_eace4c43/1_47741_output.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Lead Times']

# Modify only B5.  Use one WORKDAY call with the two lead-time values as an array,
# and TEXT() so TEXTJOIN returns short dates rather than Excel serial numbers.
ws['B5'] = '=TEXTJOIN("-",,TEXT(WORKDAY(B4,{10,12},$K$14:$K$20),"mm/dd/yyyy"))'

# Ensure calculation is enabled when opened in Excel/LibreOffice.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: reopen and print B5.
check = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
print(check['Lead Times']['B5'].value)
